name: Engr. Wale Osamiluyi, FNSE, FNIEE, FNIWE
title: Founder & Managing Director
bio: Wale founded Sato in 1997 and is responsible for the overall running of the company. He is an electrical engineer by training and has grown the firm from a start-up into an engineering and infrastructure business working across infrastructure, energy, and oil and gas.
qualifications: BEng Electrical Engineering, University of Ilorin
MSc Project Management, University of Cape Town, South Africa
MBA Global Business, Rotman School of Management, University of Toronto, Canada
Global Executive MBA, University of St. Gallen, Switzerland
memberships: Member, Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (MRICS)
Fellow, Institute for Government Research and Leadership Technology

name: Engr. Popoola Oyenola
title: Executive Director, Projects & Development
bio: Popoola is a civil engineer with a particular interest in design, and oversees the delivery of Sato's projects.
qualifications: BEng Civil Engineering (second class upper division)
yearsExperience: Over 36 years in the construction industry

name: Olubunmi Ajileye
title: Project Manager
bio: Olubunmi manages projects so that they meet and, where possible, exceed what the client asked for.
qualifications: First-class BSc Civil Engineering, Technical University of Cluj-Napoca, Romania (1982)
yearsExperience: Over 34 years in the construction industry

name: Olatunde Opeyemi
title: Project Manager
bio: Olatunde works in contracts administration and on-site project management, and supports the development of younger members of the team.
qualifications: BSc Chemical Engineering, University of Lagos
MSc Computing Information Engineering with Project Management, Robert Gordon University, Aberdeen, Scotland

name: Samuel Kolawole
title: Manager, Plants & Equipment
bio: Samuel manages the company's vehicles, plant and equipment, including trucks, bulldozers, wheel loaders, excavators and backhoe loaders.

name: Taiwo Adekola
title: Project Engineer
bio: Taiwo works to bring projects in on schedule, within budget and to specification.
